# TheStage Android SDK — agent index
# On-device inference for Android on Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 / 8 Gen 3 /
# 8 Elite / 8 Elite Gen 5 (Hexagon NPU; a model's portable CPU build where it
# publishes one and the chip has no NPU build).
# Source of truth for customer docs: docs/*.md

## Init (required)
- Kotlin: TheStageAI.registerContext(context); TheStageAI.initialize(api_token = "...")   // suspend
- Flutter: TheStageFlutterSDK.initialize(api_token: '...')
- Seat: (apiToken, deviceId) — see licensing.md / product_terms.md
- Pricing: Service Request at https://app.thestage.ai/contact — no public rate card

## Imports
- Kotlin core: import ai.thestage.qlip.TheStageAI      // object (singleton)
- Flutter: package:thestage_android_sdk/thestage_android_sdk.dart
  → class TheStageFlutterSDK

## Flutter surface (TheStageFlutterSDK, snake_case)
- start_model / stop_model / infer / infer_stream
- send / finish_stream / stop_stream (push text into a TTS infer_stream by stream_id)
- stream_append / stream_finish / stream_cancel (push audio into a diarization infer_stream)
- ASREngine(stt:, vad:).infer / ASRStream.open (send_pcm, flush, close, cancel) — ASR
- TSASREngine (start / stop; turns, transcripts, partial_transcripts,
  vad_probabilities, events, speaker_events) — live ASR, SDK owns the mic
- prefetch_model / on_progress (single global load-progress stream)
- device: unset = best build for the phone; 'npu' / 'cpu' = required
  (fails when unpublished); 'gpu' refused
- installed_models / available_updates / update_available — a load never
  replaces an installed model; take an update with
  prefetch_model(replace_existing: true)
- remove_model(model_type, repository) / maintain / reset_models — free space
- ensureDeveloperLogs (mirrors SDK log ring into `flutter run` in debug)

## Kotlin core symbols
- TheStageAI (object): start_model, stop_model, infer, infer_stream,
  open_tts_streamer, asr_engine, asr_pipeline, stream_append, stream_finish,
  prefetch_model, installed_models, available_updates,
  remove_model, delete_model, maintain, reset_models, recent_logs, set_log_listener,
  record_log, record_error, last_error / last_error_code
- TheStageLLM                          // LFM2.5 / LFM3 / Qwen3.5 chat
- Tool, ToolCall, LlmStreamEvent       // tool calling: infer_stream(..., tools, max_tool_rounds = 4)
- DefaultTools                         // built-in tools: live, web, phone, voice, all, web_mock; voice_system_prompt
- ASREngine, ASRStream, ASRResult      // ASR: infer, open_stream, mic mode (start/stop)
- WhisperModel, WhisperPipeline        // Whisper engine + ASR pipeline
- TheStageVLM                          // VLM: images + prompt -> text (LFM2.5-VL, Gemma 4)
- ModelStatus.features                 // "mtp" / "thinking" / "tools": supported, default (start_model)
- NeuTTSMultilingual, NeuTTS           // TTS: 9-lang multilingual (nano + full), English nano
- PhononTTSPipeline                    // TTS: Phonon 31M, Pocket TTS 18M (English) and 100M (fr de it es pt nl ja zh ko hi pl tr el ru)
- SileroVAD                            // stateful VAD
- TheStageVoiceAgent, TheStageAgentConfig   // full voice agent
- SpeakerId                            // model_type "speaker-id" (TheStageAI/speaker-id-v2)
- GLiNERel                             // model_type "glinerel": entities, PII, relations; free-text labels; redact
- EmbeddingGemma, EmbeddingInput        // model_type "embedding-gemma": text (300m); text, image, audio, video (EmbeddingGemma 2)
- MobileClip2ImageEncoder              // model_type "mobile-clip-image": image -> 512-d unit vector (NPU, CPU bundle elsewhere)
- SamplingParams                      // sampling overrides (ignored: greedy models)

## Pages
- README.md — index, quick start, audio contract, model cache
- llm.md — TheStageLLM chat, streaming, messages history, n_ctx (context up to 32768), use_mtp, enable_thinking,
  tool calling (Kotlin Tool.execute loop; Flutter manual loop, built-in tools)
- whisper.md — WhisperModel ASR
- vlm.md — TheStageVLM (images + prompt -> text, LFM2.5-VL, Gemma 4); messages history
  (images encoded once, earlier turns kept); Gemma 4 chat requests (tools, thinking)
- tts.md — NeuTTS + NeuTTSMultilingual
- phonon.md — PhononTTSPipeline (model_type phonon / pocket-tts), voice_dir voices
- vad.md — SileroVAD
- streaming.md — TTS / LLM stream contracts, back-pressure
- voice_agent.md — full agent (VAD→STT→LLM→TTS, smart-turn, barge-in,
  auto_listen / begin_listening, send_request, custom nodes)
- model_management.md — device choice, availability, prefetch, installed
  models + updates, reclaiming space, load/unload, memory
- ai_packs.md — ship models via Google Play AI packs (aipack:// engines source)
- speaker_embedding.md — speaker-id enroll / cosine verify (NPU; CPU elsewhere)
- glinerel.md — glinerel: text + entity / relation labels -> entities, relations, redacted_text
  (UTF-16 offsets; entities + 2 x relations <= 32 labels a call)
- embedding_gemma.md — embedding-gemma: text / image_path / audio_path / video_path
  (+ max_frames), task, dimension (768/512/256/128) -> embedding, embedding_b64,
  embedding_space_id, token_count, truncated (EmbeddingGemma 2 cuts text at 2048
  tokens; 300m averages 2048-token pieces)
- mobileclip2.md — mobile-clip-image: image (file path) -> 512-d embedding;
  empty list when the image is unreadable
- diarization.md — who spoke when (nemotron-diarization) / who said what
  (nemotron-multispeaker composite: segments, enrollment, streaming)
- licensing.md — (apiToken, deviceId) seat, reinstall, online-validation behavior
- product_terms.md — commercial terms summary (pricing = Service Request)
- logging.md — diagnostics ring, session log file, `logs` EventChannel

## LLM tool calling
- Models: LFM2.5 230M/350M/1.2B, LFM3-1.7B, Qwen3.5 0.8B/2B/4B; Gemma 4 E2B (vlm.md: messages / tools on a gemma4-vl handle). LFM2.5-VL: no.
  No tool format in the bundle + tools -> throws "This bundle has no tool_calling spec…"
- Kotlin: Tool(name, description, parameters JSON Schema, execute = { call -> String });
  the SDK runs execute and continues the same Flow<LlmStreamEvent>:
  TextDelta | ThinkingDelta | ToolCallEvent | ToolResult | ToolRound | Final
- Flutter / JSON: input_json 'tools': [{name, description, parameters}],
  optional 'max_tool_rounds'. The app runs tools: stream -> tool_call chunk
  {name, arguments} -> final {stop_reason: 'tool_calls'}; append
  {'role': 'assistant', 'content': final_text, 'tool_calls': [...]} and
  {'role': 'tool', 'content': result} to 'messages', call infer_stream again
- Chunk kinds with tools: text_delta (only text to show) / thinking_delta /
  tool_call / tool_result / final {stop_reason, final_text, tool_calls,
  thinking, raw_text}; without tools: text / final as before
- stop_reason adds "tool_calls" and "max_tool_rounds"; markup never in text_delta
- DefaultTools web tools call Open-Meteo, DuckDuckGo, Wikipedia (network);
  phone tools open system UI (registerContext needed); nothing is logged

## Audio rates (PCM float, mono, samples in [-1, 1])
- VAD / Whisper / speaker embedding input: 16 kHz mono Float
- VAD frame: 512 samples (32 ms)
- TTS output (NeuTTS / NeuTTSMultilingual / PhononTTSPipeline): 24 kHz mono Float
- Speaker embedding window: 2.0 s (32 000 samples), output 192-d L2-norm

## Compute
- LLM, VLM and Whisper encoder/decoder run on the Hexagon NPU (TheStage's
  own NPU runtime; greedy decoding); NeuTTS and Phonon / Pocket TTS
  run on TheStage's NPU runtime too
- EmbeddingGemma (NPU only) and MobileCLIP2 (NPU; CPU bundle on other
  phones and as fallback) run there as well, and so do speaker-id and
  the wake word's embedding (each with a CPU bundle for other phones)
- Small stateful models (Silero VAD, smart-turn) run on ORT-CPU
- Kotlin audio buffers: FloatArray; Flutter: Float32List (never Float64List)
